  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When SCRIPT_REF is not a commit SHA and does not resolve as a ref, the helper sets `stage_support_verify="head_only"`, emits a warning, and still stages whatever `HEAD` is checked out.
  WHY: On the stable-to-main checkout fallback in `clarify.yml` (`SCRIPT_REF=stable` but `main` checked out), unverified support scripts from `main` are staged into `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR`, which leads to runtime mismatches like the `codex_stall_guard.sh` error originally reported; the source severity was MAJOR, mapped here to high. The same path is filed as a task gap by minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna, while anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly chose not to flag it, because the fallback is deliberate and the warning was the accepted mitigation.

  Evidence of absence: For a non-SHA SCRIPT_REF with no local tags/remotes/heads match, `stage_support_verify` stays `head_only`; the last run only added a `::warning::`. Staging proceeds with whatever HEAD is checked out (the main-fallback path keeps `SCRIPT_REF=stable`, per clarify.yml lines 434-442).   SEVERITY: MAJOR

The editor summary says "I did not edit the PR body. You will need to add a note there for the out-of-scope docs/ edits." The edits are justified; the disclosure is absent.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh lines 137-150, `head_only` branch. The helper silently degrades to staging the checked-out HEAD on an unresolved ref; the `::warning::` gives no structured signal, so other causes (a SCRIPT_REF typo, a renamed support ref) pass the wrong bundle. Suggested fix: emit `SUPPORT_REF_UNRESOLVED=${SCRIPT_REF}` to GITHUB_OUTPUT/GITHUB_ENV for a downstream `if:` guard (~5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
